title: Communications — Audio Management Unit — Installation of the Perforated Tray and Revised Rack Guide
abstract: Installation of a perforated mounting tray and a revised rack guide for the audio management unit, removing the thermal throttling that produces intermittent interphone loss on long ground stops.

sections.planning_reason: Line stations report intermittent loss of flight interphone and of the cabin call function during long turnarounds, always on aircraft whose audio management unit is in the upper rack position and always after more than an hour on ground power. Twenty-eight of thirty-one returned units tested serviceable on the bench. A thermal survey found the upper position running eighteen degrees hotter than the lower one because the tray blanks the cooling path, and the unit throttles its audio processing rather than failing, which is why the fault never reproduces on the bench.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the mounting tray with a perforated item that opens the cooling path under the unit, and fits a revised lower guide in the rack so that the unit seats forty millimetres further forward and clears the rear bulkhead. The retaining screws are replaced to suit the thinner tray flange. No harness is disturbed and no wiring is changed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: De-energise the rack and remove ground power. Get access to the flight compartment rack in zones 211 and 214. Remove the audio management unit and the mounting tray D2350116486608 following task AMM-Z-23-50-11-000-029-A. Install the perforated tray and check that the cooling aperture beneath it is clear. Install the revised lower guide in the rack LU507538-19 and check the forward seating dimension against the instructions. Install the retaining screws AES832388-10. Check that the display unit GRA872629-19 in the same column is undisturbed and correctly seated. Install the audio management unit and lock it in the tray. Restore power and do the audio integrating system operational test, including a flight interphone check from both flight deck stations and a cabin call check from the control panel at FIN 8830RC.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft in the MSN Z01868 to Z08218 range whose audio management unit is in the upper rack position. One aircraft withdrawn from service is excluded. Aircraft with the later rack layout are not affected because that layout already opens the cooling path.
sections.material_note: Kit K2350-1006-01 contains the perforated tray, the lower guide and the screw set for one aircraft. All items are short-lead. The removed tray is scrap.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next avionics rack activity, whichever occurs first.
